summary: Practise job hazard analysis, control selection and safety documentation. Explore OSHA compliance training and apply the methods to workplace scenarios.
lede: OSHA compliance training helps safety officers, supervisors and operations professionals assess workplace hazards, select controls and maintain safety records. Through job hazard analysis, workplace inspections and incident documentation, learners practise building risk registers, tracking corrective actions and communicating unresolved risks, using the hierarchy of controls and ISO 45001:2018 as practical references. Regulatory interpretation is covered at overview level; local applicability requires separate review.
audienceIntro: The course suits professionals who inspect work, assign safety controls or review the evidence used to track workplace hazards and incidents.
modules: Job Hazard Analysis and Risk Registers
prerequisites: You don't need an OSHA qualification to join. Experience with workplace procedures, or responsibility for safety tasks, will help you apply the scenarios.
